ICS 81.080MTD 15New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the method for determining the thermal conductivity of Dense and Insulating refractories by the water calorimetric method.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
